state: specified before running the support screen
scope: All 2000 food and 576 Swissmetro archived allocations. Keep respondent splits, attributes, choices and archived predictions. Use the archived labelled ridge point as the reference.
reference_state: Existing support LP and interval checks. At unit power, a strict cap below one implies exterior support.
tests: positive definite observed compensated Hessian and finite Newton direction
strictly positive tangent menu probabilities with a matched corrected moment
strictly negative recession in the normalized Newton direction
certified but undirected symmetric norm bound implied by the same primal check
statistics: Report both types of decision, unresolved fractions, conditional counts, false decisions against independent support, and applicable results by dataset, specification and budget.
application: One-pass pre-screen with original support program for every unresolved allocation. No new tuning, model fitting or human data.
